content:
mohit: incoming pen-test next Fri. need to finalize ephemeral RBAC + KMS decrypt for evidence. tagging @dina @carla
dina: scope? staging only? any db reads?
mohit: staging + sandbox only. no db. they need short-lived decrypts to verify artifact integrity.
carla: require evidence_manifest.json with sha256s and manifest.sig. presign s3 for 24h and place under sec-audit-bucket/pentest/<engagement>/
ashley: ops: snapshot SIEM 30m before and keep 14d retention for the export. include pause flag to cut assessor access if noise hits prod.
mohit: ephemeral role: assessor/ephemeral with s3:GetObject on the evidence prefix, kms:Decrypt on alias/pentest-evidence-key, logs:FilterLogEvents on audit group. conditions: sourceIp + time window. max session 1h.
dina: add explicit deny for kms:CreateGrant and GenerateDataKey. log assume-role to central audit account.
oncall-bot: Reminder: pen-test scheduled 2026-06-11 10:00-16:00 UTC. paging: security-oncall.
carla: propose retest 2026-06-18 10:00-12:00 UTC. I'll tentatively block.
mohit: action items: @dina draft intake + manifest template, @carla block retest & snapshot, @ashley update runbook + pause flag. I'll open role PR and link here.
carla: checklist for PR: [ephemeral-role], [presigned-prefix], [manifest validation], [audit-export job], [runbook link]. :white_check_mark:
